text:
tyler: Heads-up: planning a geo-phased rollout for redwood-3.0.0 in ~15m. Sequence: US -> EU -> APAC. Baseline canary 3%, 10m pin. Will update if any region needs special handling.

nisha: Running fast preflight (GPU headroom + queue depth). Posting results in 2.

infra-push: Preflight results:
US: free GPUs 110/140 (78%), queues low
EU: free GPUs 62/85 (72%), queues low
APAC: free GPUs 26/60 (43%), queues moderate

ben: APAC under threshold. Options: warm +4 nodes, reduce APAC canary to 1%, or delay APAC. Recommend warming now and aim for 60%+.

sre-ellen: Also set rollback thresholds: error_rate >0.5% sustained for 4m or p95 >2x baseline for 3m. We'll auto-trigger rollback if either hits.

tyler: Agreed. infra-push, please spin warmpool +4 in APAC. Starting US canary once warmpool initiated.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled by tyler. release=redwood-3.0.0 regions=[us,eu,apac] canary=0.03 pin=10m rollback=[err>0.5%:4m,p95>2x:3m] Use `/deploy status 1776000000`.

infra-push: Warmpool +4 requested for APAC. ETA ~6m. Starting US canary now. `/deploy start --release redwood-3.0.0 --region us --canary 0.03 --pin 10m`

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: US canary started (slice s-901). Obs: https://console.redwood/obs/s-901

ben: Watching US: p95 stable +7ms, 500_rate unchanged, kv_cache_miss_rate normal.

nisha: US pin complete and green. Proceeding to EU. `/deploy start --release redwood-3.0.0 --region eu --canary 0.03 --pin 10m`

deploy-bot: EU canary started (slice s-902).

infra-push: APAC warmup complete: new free GPUs 34/64 (53%). Still below 60%.

tyler: APAC still tight. Change plan: APAC micro-canary 0.5% with 20m pin for extra observation. Update config and we'll start micro-canary only if staging smoke passes. `/deploy update 1776000000 --region apac --canary 0.005 --pin 20m`

deploy-bot: APAC config updated. Micro-canary set to 0.5% with 20m pin.

sre-ellen: Strongly recommend excluding any hosts with known recent config pushes from micro-canary routing. I'll add a temporary routing exclude rule for apac-suspect-* hosts.

ben: Starting APAC micro-canary only after staging smoke is green. Infra please run staging smoke now.

infra-push: Running staging smoke against APAC shard map...

infra-push: Staging smoke passed. Starting APAC micro-canary (slice s-903) 0.5%.

deploy-bot: :warning: APAC micro-canary s-903 reports kv_cache_miss_rate spike at +3m (1.3%) and small uptick in 500s.

ben: Observed stacktrace: `ShardRoutingError` from kv-router on apac-w-4. Correlates with `kv_rebalance` in recent config push.

sre-ellen: Initiating immediate rollback for s-903. `/deploy rollback --slice s-903 --reason "ShardRoutingError apac-w-4"`

deploy-bot: :arrows_counterclockwise: Rollback initiated and completed for slice s-903. Pin released. APAC traffic reverted to previous variant.

infra-push: Isolating apac-w-4 and kicking config-sync + restart. Will validate shard maps and run additional staging smoke.

tyler: Good catch. Holding APAC until infra confirms fixes. We'll keep US/EU on redwood-3.0.0. Open incident INC-2027-001 and add logs + obs links.

ben: I'll draft a short rollback blameless note for the incident (cause hypothesis: partial config push + kv rebalance timing). Include repro steps.

sre-ellen: For next attempt let's: 1) run shard map verify across APAC pool, 2) exclude recently touched hosts from canary routing, 3) start tiny canary (0.25%) for 10m then 0.5% if green.

tyler: Sounds good. Thanks team. If infra confirms warm pool / shard fix I'll re-schedule APAC attempt. Ping here when ready. :thumbsup:
